payload.core_mechanism_summary: Scans all split points i, computing max(a[i]-1, 10^6 - a[i+1]), and takes the minimum, also considering one person taking all prizes.
payload.rationale: Optimal assignment partitions prizes contiguously; an exchange argument proves contiguity. The loop evaluates each split's worst-case time and selects the best, fitting greedy exchange argument pattern.
